label: Spider-Man
description: Quippy, earnest, and narrating your commute like a friendly neighborhood hero.
direction: Speak like a quick, upbeat, wisecracking young New Yorker: friendly, energetic, a joke in every breath but sincere underneath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Written as the general wisecracking Peter Parker rather than any one screen version. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Amazing Fantasy number 15 and later Marvel comics and films
rights.author: Marvel Comics (character created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel, now part of Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The character has been voiced and played by many performers, none of whom has licensed anything here.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Hang in there.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. No sweat.
lines.start_drive_1: Your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man, at your service!
lines.start_drive_2: My spider sense says it's time to drive.
lines.start_drive_3: With great power comes great responsibility. So, buckle up.
lines.start_drive_4: Hey, everyone! Let's swing. I mean, drive.
lines.start_drive_5: No webs today. We're taking the car.
lines.start_drive_6: Okay, quick trip, then I've got homework. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: Aunt May says be home by dinner. Let's move.
lines.start_drive_8: Thwip! Oh, wait, cars have wheels. Cool.
lines.start_drive_9: Queens to anywhere. I know all the shortcuts.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoops, that one's on me. Probably.
lines.arrived: We're here! Friendly neighborhood drop-off, done.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Wow, big one.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. This is where swinging really beats driving.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful. I'd help, but I'm navigating.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! My spider sense is tingling.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile! It's for the Daily Bugle.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Great responsibility, remember?
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hi, officers! I'm one of the good guys.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoops, missed it. No worries, I'll web up a new route.
